description: Submit workflow JSON to ComfyUI. By default waits for a result with outputs; wait=false returns prompt_id immediately. include_events adds the last 10 progress events and total event count. auto combines WebSocket with polling; websocket subscribes then checks history once to recover fast runs, with no recurring polling; polling avoids WebSocket. Inspect submitted runs with get_execution. Requires COMFYUI_HOST.

include_events.description: Collect recent progress events; requires wait=true and a non-polling transport

progress_transport.description: auto uses WebSocket plus polling; websocket requires a connection and checks history once after subscribing; polling uses history only

timeout_ms.description: Completion timeout; defaults to resource recommendation or 300000ms

wait.description: Wait for completion; false only queues the workflow

workflow.description: Workflow JSON from build_workflow, get_workflow_json, or load_workflow

name: execute_workflow
